page.overview:
Who is Barry DePedal?

Barry DePedal is a next-generation racer sponsored by RPM who competes in the Piston Cup Racing Series. He enters the Piston Cup mid-season, replacing the previous RPM racer, Bruce Miller. His number is 64, just like Bruce and Winford Bradford Rutherford.
